s1: Every Monday, a beauty marketing team in Taiwan has to explain why sales moved, and how to answer competitors. Our dashboard says the hero line is down fifty-five percent. Is it?
s2: Meet Ace, a Gemini agent. A Flash-Lite router writes the plan, then Gemini 3.8 Flash runs a tool loop through the Interactions API, querying the sales data like-for-like and streaming every step.
s3: The verdict: 2026 only has half a year of data. Like-for-like, the line is actually up five percent, carried by Cushion Foundation, and every finding cites the exact row, one click away.
s4a: One switch re-skins every brand for a safe demo: Cola, Pika, or K-pop. Ace still works on the real data underneath.
s4b: Gemini with Google Search grounding then scans Dcard, PTT, Instagram and Threads for three rival cushions: share of voice, sentiment, and what consumers actually talk about, every post linked to its source.
s5: Ace combines that social scan, live momo prices it scrapes itself, and our sales rows into one cited brief. And Gradium reads it out loud.
s6: Ace only proposes. Nothing happens until I approve, and every decision is logged.
s7: CokeZerope Marketing, built today with the Gemini Interactions API, Google Search grounding, Deep Research, Gradium voice, and Entire. A Monday of spreadsheets becomes a two-minute, cited, human-approved brief.
